column1: # gates/contract-asserts.tsv - CLAUSES WHOSE CONTRACT IS A RUNNABLE ASSERT, read by gates/audit/contract-asserts.sh (door check
# Columns: clause <TAB> status <TAB> input <TAB> command <TAB> note
#   clause   a rule id from prompts/rule-contracts (R43), or <file>#<clause> for a clause that is not a numbered rule (CLAUDE.md#...).
#   status   assert       the clause is IN FORCE and its command is its predicate: exit 0 holds, 1 is a breach, 2 could not run.
#            not-in-force the clause is named and deliberately not asserted; the note must say why. Reported every run, never a pass.
#   input    tree         the command reads this repository and runs in the door.
#            export:<coll> the command reads a tracker export (ArtifactData out_dir); it runs only when CT_CONTRACT_EXPORT names a
#                          directory holding <coll>/, and is reported NOT CHECKED HERE otherwise.
#   command  a path under gates/audit/ and its arguments; {export} is replaced by the export directory.
# The UNIVERSE line names every clause the register must account for. A universe clause with no row is reported NOT IN FORCE (NO
# ROW) - control (c) - and is not a pass. Its rule ids are prompts/rule-contracts' completeness.ruleSetGoverned at document version
# 26 (read 14 Nov 2026), so they are a COPY and can go stale; `--universe-from <rule-contracts export json>` reads the live list.
